description: Cross-source daily grid boundary mismatch: OKX (16:00 UTC) vs Binance (00:00 UTC) BTC 1D, 30 bars each.

expected.reason: day_boundary_utc differs (okx=16:00, binance=00:00); engine must not compute per-bar diffs
expected.remediation: resample both to a common grid; alignment accepted only if residual == 0

expected.reason: both declare day_boundary_utc=00:00 but ts_open_utc mod 86400000 differs (57600000 vs 0); declared boundary must be validated against actual timestamps — this case MUST red, computing a diff is a fail
bars with close_time_utc > as_of must be excluded from the denominator; count must be reported as "processed N (expected M)"
empty input is neither PASS nor FAIL; must carry a source, not silently treated as zero-diff
